topic: Can I claim clinical Pilates on my health fund?

slides.headline: Can you claim clinical Pilates?
slides.sub: Short answer: it depends on your fund. Here's what to ask.

slides.title: It depends on your policy
slides.body: Health fund cover for clinical Pilates varies between funds and between levels of extras cover. Two people with the same fund can get different answers, so check with your fund directly.

slides.title: Questions to ask your fund
slides.body: Is clinical Pilates covered on my extras? Does it need to be run by a physiotherapist? What's my annual limit, and is it shared with physio? Is there a waiting period?

slides.title: Have these ready when you call
slides.body: Your membership number, the practitioner or clinic name, and how the session will be described on your receipt. Our front desk can tell you how sessions are listed before you book.

slides.title: Claiming on the day
slides.body: If your extras cover includes the service, HICAPS lets you claim on the spot with your health fund card, so you only pay the gap. Otherwise, keep your receipt and check how your fund handles claims.

slides.title: Plan the whole program
slides.body: Clinical Pilates tends to help most as a regular, progressive program. Check how many sessions your limit is likely to cover, then plan a realistic frequency with our team.

slides.headline: Ready to start clinical Pilates?
slides.body: Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physiotherapy starts with an assessment and builds a program around your goals. Check with your fund first, then book in.

caption:
Wondering if your health fund will chip in for clinical Pilates?

The honest answer is that it depends on your fund and your level of extras cover. Two people with the same fund can get different answers, so it's worth a quick call before you start.

Ask your fund: is clinical Pilates covered on my extras, does it need to be run by a physiotherapist, what's my annual limit, is it shared with physio, and is there a waiting period? Our front desk can tell you how sessions are listed on the receipt. If you're covered, HICAPS lets you claim on the spot and pay just the gap.

Once you know your limit, our Pilates team can help you plan a realistic program. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.

story.headline: Claiming clinical Pilates?
story.body: It depends on your fund and policy. Ask about cover, annual limits and waiting periods before you start.
